changes: SCALE QUANTIZER on MIDI tracks (the author’s octatrick 2.13 quantizer, timhastie/octatrick-modules 48b89e7): with a scale on, a MIDI track’s NOTE knob and NOTE locks step through the scale’s notes from ROOT, and the MIDI CHROMATIC keys play the scale from ROOT (key 1 sounds the root; the number beside the keyboard reads the root and the octave, for example “A 3”).

chord offsets (NOT2–NOT4), the arpeggiator, TRAN, MIDI IN and the sequencer are unchanged on MIDI tracks: the quantizer acts where a note is edited or played from the panel (ARP SETUP KEY still forces every note a track sends into a key). SCALE OFF is unchanged.

the MIDI chromatic freeze is fixed in the author’s own line: since 2.13 his quantizer hooks the CHROMATIC drawer at its common argument push (0x400449be), the form of Modwerk’s 0.1.2 fix for #264, credited to the Modwerk contributors. The bundled quantizer’s sources are now the author’s, byte for byte (its manifest in Modwerk’s stock_guard form); FM Synth images carried the fix already.
the FM engine, the FM SYNTH chooser and the page are unchanged from 0.1.4: the same compiled objects at the same addresses in the image.

Emulator checks on this exact image (TESTING.md): the NOTE knob and locks against a model of the rules (409 of 409), the CHROMATIC keys (245 of 245), SCALE OFF equal to stock, the quantizer’s added cost, exact memory, two-track Part/project save and reload. The author’s MKI report of this exact image is pending; physical reboot survival is not yet verified.
